title: The Ghost Pirate Menace
description: Larton hasn't seen open water in two months. The ghost pirates hold the bay from an island stronghold, and every week the blockade holds is a week less grain in Larton's stores before what's left has to last the whole winter. Mayor Kendrick needs the water open again before hunger does what the pirates haven't - Old Willem knows the bay in the dark and can get you to a stronghold nobody else has come back from.

objectives.description: Ask Old Willem where the ghost ship makes its lair
Travel to the Pirate Stronghold in the bay
Tell Mayor Kendrick the bay is open

notes: Root cause of the Larton/Aberdeen supply crisis carried through starving_south, retake_harbor, supply_line_crisis and aberdeen_relief - the blockade this quest lifts is why Larton was starving and thin-guarded enough for bandits to take the harbor warehouses. The cross-reference is prose only; on_complete_flags unchanged.
